title: Sarah Rogers: Free Speech, AI Diplomacy, and What America Owes Its Allies

reader_summary.headline: AI is going to be more important, not less important.
reader_summary.overview: AI is going to be more important, not less important. The rules around AI are changing fast. There's a lot of regulation abroad around digital safety and misinformation that's in some ways becoming the Petri dish for lobbying groups and organizations in America to bring that here..

key_points.text: AI is going to be more important, not less important.
key_points.evidence_quote: AI is going to be more important, not less important, and so the proliferation of a Western AI stack to be a top priority for anyone who cares about freedom.

key_points.evidence_quote: Economist Haller Cowan talks about AI with a Western soul, and I completely agree with him that that is the greatest soft power tool we can possess.

thesis: Sarah Rogers argues that the proliferation of a Western AI stack that prioritizes individual reasoning, user consent, and rule-based principles is the United States' most important soft power tool. She contends that while previous administrations engaged in censorship and content removal to combat disinformation, her office now pursues transparency, truth, and reconciliation to make freedom of expression a primary prong of public diplomacy.
